description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Saga of the Great Wolf enhancement SKJALD'S FORETELLING (WP-S2): the Wolf Guard Battle Leader's unit's melee attacks have [LANCE] (11e: +1 to wound if the unit made a charge move this turn). Fixture sw11e_s2_wolves_active (the Battle Leader carries it). Setup privileges (in the Command phase, before the Fight phase starts): CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation, and the Battle Leader is placed in base contact with the Meganobz as if it had charged them this turn (charged_this_turn); then straight to the Fight phase (P1 active). The fight_phase_start window (Howlmaw, not under test) is declined; both players end their pile-in; a real click selects the Battle Leader to fight; its attacks go at the Meganobz; the melee wound rolls carry +1 from [LANCE] (the modifier ledger names it; none of its weapons has [LANCE] natively).

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description), then straight to the Fight phase
steps.script:
var H = load("res://tests/helpers/cus11e_c5_scen.gd")
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
H.move_to("U_WOLF_GUARD_BATTLE_LEADER_A", 35.83, 30.15)
GameState.state.units["U_WOLF_GUARD_BATTLE_LEADER_A"].flags["charged_this_turn"] = true
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(10)
return RulesEngine.is_unit_engaged("U_WOLF_GUARD_BATTLE_LEADER_A", GameState.state)

steps.comment: the melee wound roll's modifier ledger names [LANCE] (+1, the unit charged this turn)
clean log: no ERROR line in this session's debug log
